name: bb-plugin-navmotion-skin

bb.name: NavMotion Skin
bb.description: Three NavMotion skins with moving grounds (Dots, Live, Tunnel), a Skin button in the sidebar footer that keeps every skin one click away, and Markdown in the chat box with a live Preview tab on the side.

themes.name: NavMotion Dots
themes.description: Calm paper that never stops moving: a drifting dot ground, white cards, ink type.

themes.name: NavMotion Live
themes.description: The ground shows what your agents are doing: dots when idle, silk while working, a halo when done.

themes.name: NavMotion Tunnel
themes.description: The dark studio from the films: outlines growing out of the centre, plum smoke inside the interface.

description: The NavMotion look for bb: three moving skins (Dots, Live, Tunnel), a one-click Skin button, and Markdown formatting in the chat box with a live side preview.
